Services / Websites & applications

Websites & apps,
built around your users.

A website, customer portal or native app starts with the actions people need to take. I connect those screens to the data and services behind them.

What I can build

The right scope, not every feature.

Websites

Responsive service sites and focused landing pages with clear navigation, content, forms and primary actions.

Web applications

Customer portals, dashboards and internal tools, with scoped roles, authentication, data and workflows.

Native iOS

Swift and SwiftUI interfaces, API connections and local data, with target-device testing and release preparation.

From scope to handover

Make the main journey work.

  • Define the user journey

    Agree on who the product serves, the main screens and what each action needs to do.

  • Connect the product

    Plan APIs, forms, authentication, payments or bookings where the agreed scope requires them.

  • Test the agreed experience

    Check key flows, responsive layouts and accessibility against the agreed browsers and devices.

  • Prepare the handover

    Document the build, release steps and any maintenance that needs an ongoing agreement.
